comment: The sync mode parameter has no widget on the panel and lives only on the right-click menu. The output is not clamped: TrackerPhase.cpp:139 adds the offset, which covers -5 to +5V, to a wave scaled by up to 10V, so the pair can be set to reach 15V. The manual names the shapes saw, triangle, sine and square; the code's first shape is a rising ramp, and the warp exponent is applied to the phase before the shape is taken, which is why it stretches rather than distorts.
